meta.title: About
meta.description: The story and mission of WinDe Exam.

title: About the {name} system
intro: Hello! Welcome to {name}, a modern online learning and testing platform built to help teachers and students create, take, and manage exams quickly, conveniently, and effectively.

goals.title: Our goals
goals.intro: The application is designed to help schools, learning centers, and individuals easily:
items: Create tests by skill or subject.
Manage classes, student rosters, and exams for each class.
Track test progress, grade automatically, and display results instantly.
Run online exams with time limits, attempt limits, and class-based access restrictions.

items.label: Flexible test creation:
items.text: Teachers can build their own tests or pick questions from the question bank.

items.label: Class management:
items.text: Create classes, approve student enrollment, and track learning progress.

items.label: Multimedia storage:
items.text: Attach images, audio, and documents to each question.

items.label: Statistical reports:
items.text: Summaries of scores, time spent, and detailed learning results.

community.title: Community focus
community.body: {name} is not just a place to test your knowledge but also an interactive learning environment where teachers can share materials and students can learn from one another through online classes.

contact.title: Contact & Feedback
contact.body: If you have feedback or would like to see a feature improved, please get in touch. Every piece of feedback helps {name} serve you better.

thankYou: Thank you for trusting and using our system. We wish you effective learning and teaching!
